name: HeatXR
summary:
YOUR WORKOUT, NEVER THE SAME TWICE
HeatXR builds every session new, matched to the beat, the phrases and the build-ups of the music, so you never memorize a routine and never run out of content.

YOUR MUSIC
Copy your own songs to the headset (MP3, M4A, AAC, FLAC, OGG, Opus or WAV) and HeatXR builds a workout around each one. Streaming services aren't supported. No songs? Beat-only workouts play on their own.
